description: Versioned settings for the primary controlled experiment (updated RAGU configuration; not a reproduction of RAGU's legacy gpt-4o-mini setup). A null value means the parameter is NOT sent to the API and the provider default applies.

temperature.note: API returned 400 unsupported_value: only the default (1) is supported by this model, so temperature cannot be used to reduce variance.

seed.note: Accepted by chat.completions.create. No system_fingerprint was returned, so backend version cannot be tracked, and acceptance does not imply deterministic output.

reasoning_effort.note: Only the value 'low' was probed. Other values (for example 'none', assumed by the RAGU adapter) are NOT verified.

max_completion_tokens.note: Accepted. A cap that is too small may truncate reasoning plus structured output; choose it deliberately.

parameter_support.note: A parameter may only be set to a non-null value above once its status is 'verified' by a recorded live probe (scripts/probe_llm_parameters.py). Otherwise enabling it raises an error. 'Verified' means the API accepted the probed value on chat.completions.create (a tiny plain request); it does not mean the parameter improves consistency, and the structured-output parse path used by the pipeline was not separately probed. All parameters remain disabled (null) by default.

llm.notes: Run 1/2/Q1 were executed with no temperature, reasoning_effort, max token or seed parameter sent, so these nulls describe how those results were produced. LLM output is not guaranteed reproducible without a seed; entity/edge counts differed between Run 1 and Run 2.

install_check.environment: isolated venv outside the repo (%LOCALAPPDATA%/verifiable-semantic-rag/venv-ragu-py314), Python 3.14.4, Windows 11
install_check.result: installed; imports and offline initialization succeeded; no API calls made

ragu.notes: third_party/ is git-ignored, so this pin is the record of the exact RAGU version. RAGU was installed on Python 3.14.4 although its classifiers list 3.10-3.12; import, initialization and live runtime (two graph builds, querying) verified on 2026-11-24 (results/ragu_build_*.json, results/benchmark_answers_ragu.json).
